'''Keltas Gurn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant who resided on the [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keltas Gurn appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as Companion Customization Importer vendor on the Republic fleet.
